feedback.delivery_plan_not_ready: You have not yet identified your delivery facility. Discuss this with your healthcare provider soon.
feedback.emergency_plan_not_ready: You still need to complete important emergency preparations, such as identifying emergency contacts and backup transportation.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.week1_body: Hi! Have you already identified where you plan to give birth? Take a moment to check if you know your planned delivery facility and how to reach it.
reminders.week2_body: Birth Prep Check! Do you already have primary and backup transportation plans for getting to your delivery facility?
reminders.week3_body: It's time to check your delivery essentials! Have you prepared the items you and your baby may need?
reminders.week4_body: Quick reminder! Do you know the pregnancy warning signs that require urgent medical attention?

delivery_plan.q1: Where do you plan to give birth?
delivery_plan.q1_a: At the hospital or birthing facility where I have my prenatal checkups
delivery_plan.q1_b: At home because it is more comfortable
delivery_plan.q1_c: I will decide when labor starts
delivery_plan.q1_d: I am still looking for a place
delivery_plan.q2: How will you get to the health facility when labor starts?
delivery_plan.q2_a: I will wait for my husband or family to find a ride
delivery_plan.q2_b: I already have a planned ride, such as a tricycle, car, or other transportation
delivery_plan.q2_c: I will find a ride only when labor starts
delivery_plan.q2_d: I have not thought about it yet
delivery_plan.q3: Who will most likely accompany you when you go to the health facility?
delivery_plan.q3_a: My husband/partner or another trusted family member
delivery_plan.q3_b: Anyone who happens to be available
delivery_plan.q4: Have you already talked with your family about where you will give birth?
delivery_plan.q4_a: Yes, and they know where I plan to deliver
delivery_plan.q4_b: I mentioned it once, but we have no clear plan
delivery_plan.q4_c: No, we will talk about it when labor starts
delivery_plan.q4_d: I have not talked to them about it
delivery_plan.q5: What will you do if your usual transportation is not available when you need to go to the health facility?
delivery_plan.q5_c: Look for a ride after my contractions become stronger
delivery_plan.q5_d: Stay home until someone can take me
delivery_plan.q6: Have you prepared money or another way to cover possible delivery expenses?
delivery_plan.q6_a: Yes, we have prepared money for possible expenses
delivery_plan.q6_b: We have some money but no specific plan
delivery_plan.q6_c: We will borrow money if needed
delivery_plan.q6_d: We have not prepared anything yet
delivery_plan.q7: When do you plan to prepare your hospital or delivery bag?
delivery_plan.q7_d: I have not planned it yet
delivery_plan.q8: What information should you know about your chosen health facility before delivery?
delivery_plan.q8_a: Its location, contact number, and available services
delivery_plan.q8_b: Only the name of the doctor
delivery_plan.q8_d: Only how far it is from my home
delivery_plan.q9: If your healthcare provider tells you to go to another facility for emergency care, what should you have prepared?
delivery_plan.q9_a: A backup transportation and emergency plan
delivery_plan.q9_d: I will decide what to do at that time
delivery_plan.q10: Which best describes a well-prepared delivery plan?
delivery_plan.q10_a: I know where I will give birth, how I will get there, who will accompany me, and what I need to bring
delivery_plan.q10_b: I know the hospital but have not planned transportation
delivery_plan.q10_c: I have prepared my hospital bag but have no emergency plan
delivery_plan.q10_d: I will make my plans once labor begins

hospital_bag.q1: Have you already prepared the necessary items that you may need during your hospital stay?
hospital_bag.q1_a: Yes, I have prepared most or all of the necessary items
hospital_bag.q1_b: I have prepared some items but still need to complete the bag
hospital_bag.q1_c: I have only started preparing a few items
hospital_bag.q1_d: I have not prepared any items yet
hospital_bag.q2: Have you prepared the necessary clothes and personal items for yourself?
hospital_bag.q2_a: Yes, I have prepared enough clothes and personal hygiene items
hospital_bag.q2_b: I have prepared some but still need additional items
hospital_bag.q2_c: I know what I need but have not prepared them yet
hospital_bag.q2_d: I am not sure what items I need
hospital_bag.q3: Have you prepared the necessary items for your newborn baby?
hospital_bag.q3_a: Yes, I have prepared the baby's clothes, diapers, and other needed items
hospital_bag.q3_b: I have prepared some baby items but not everything
hospital_bag.q3_c: I plan to prepare them later
hospital_bag.q3_d: I am not sure what my baby will need
hospital_bag.q4: Have you prepared the important documents that you may need at the health facility?
hospital_bag.q4_a: Yes, I have prepared my identification, prenatal records, laboratory results, and other required documents
hospital_bag.q4_b: I have some of the documents but still need to complete them
hospital_bag.q4_c: I know I need documents but have not prepared them yet
hospital_bag.q4_d: I am not sure which documents I need
hospital_bag.q5: Do you know what specific items your chosen hospital or birthing facility requires you to bring?
hospital_bag.q5_a: Yes, I know the facility's required items
hospital_bag.q5_b: I know some of the required items
hospital_bag.q5_c: I have not checked the facility's requirements yet
hospital_bag.q5_d: I do not know what the facility requires
hospital_bag.q6: Have you checked with your chosen health facility whether they provide certain supplies for the mother and newborn?
hospital_bag.q6_a: Yes, I have checked and know which supplies are provided
hospital_bag.q6_b: I have checked but still need to confirm some supplies
hospital_bag.q6_d: I do not know whether the facility provides supplies
hospital_bag.q7: Where is your hospital or delivery bag currently kept?
hospital_bag.q7_a: It is packed and kept in an easily accessible place
hospital_bag.q7_b: Most items are packed but the bag is not yet in its final location
hospital_bag.q7_c: I have gathered some items but have not packed the bag
hospital_bag.q7_d: I have not prepared or gathered the items yet
hospital_bag.q8: How ready is your hospital bag if you need to go to the health facility unexpectedly?
hospital_bag.q8_a: It is completely ready and can be taken immediately
hospital_bag.q8_b: It is almost ready but still needs a few items
hospital_bag.q8_c: It still needs several items before it is ready
hospital_bag.q9: Have you informed your partner or support person where your hospital bag and important documents are kept?
hospital_bag.q9_a: Yes, they know where everything is kept
hospital_bag.q9_b: I have told them where some of the items are
hospital_bag.q9_c: I have not told them yet
hospital_bag.q9_d: I do not have a specific place for these items yet
hospital_bag.q10: Which best describes your knowledge and preparation regarding your hospital bag?
hospital_bag.q10_a: I know what my facility requires, have prepared the necessary items and documents, and keep my bag ready in an accessible location
hospital_bag.q10_b: I know most of what I need but still have some items or documents to prepare
hospital_bag.q10_c: I know that I need a hospital bag but I am unsure about some of the required items
hospital_bag.q10_d: I have not yet learned what I need to prepare for my hospital bag

emergency_plan.q1: What should you do if you have heavy vaginal bleeding during pregnancy?
emergency_plan.q1_a: Rest and wait for it to stop.
emergency_plan.q2: What should you do if your water breaks before labor starts?
emergency_plan.q2_c: Contact your healthcare provider or go to a health facility.
emergency_plan.q3: Which symptom during pregnancy needs immediate medical attention?
emergency_plan.q4: What should you do if you feel severe abdominal pain during pregnancy?
emergency_plan.q5: What should you prepare before an emergency happens?
emergency_plan.q5_a: Emergency bag and important health records.
emergency_plan.q6: What should you do if you notice that your baby is moving much less than usual?
emergency_plan.q6_b: Seek advice from a healthcare provider promptly.
emergency_plan.q7: What should you do if you suddenly have a seizure during pregnancy?
emergency_plan.q7_c: Keep her safe from injury and seek emergency medical help.
emergency_plan.q8: What should you bring when going to the hospital for an emergency?
emergency_plan.q8_a: Prenatal records, identification, and needed medicines.
emergency_plan.q9: Why is it important to have a transportation plan?
emergency_plan.q9_a: To avoid going to the hospital.
emergency_plan.q9_b: To reach a health facility quickly during an emergency.
emergency_plan.q9_c: To save money on regular trips.
emergency_plan.q10: Which is the best way to prepare for a pregnancy emergency?
emergency_plan.q10_b: Know the warning signs, prepare an emergency bag, and plan how to get medical help.
emergency_plan.q10_d: Wait for someone else to decide what to do.

self_preparedness.q1: I feel emotionally prepared for the changes that pregnancy, childbirth, and becoming a mother may bring to my life.
self_preparedness.q2: I can manage my emotions when I experience fear, worry, or stress during pregnancy.
self_preparedness.q3: I feel confident that I can remain calm and cope with pain, fear, or unexpected situations during childbirth.
self_preparedness.q4: I have enough knowledge about pregnancy and childbirth to help reduce my fears and worries.
self_preparedness.q5: I know healthy ways to cope when I feel anxious, stressed, or emotionally overwhelmed during pregnancy.
self_preparedness.q6: I know whom to approach and feel comfortable asking for emotional support when I need it.
self_preparedness.q7: I feel confident that I can properly breastfeed my baby, including using a proper breastfeeding position and latch.
self_preparedness.q8: I feel confident that I can safely hold, carry, and handle my newborn while supporting the baby's head and neck.
self_preparedness.q9: I know how to perform basic newborn care, such as diaper changing, keeping my baby clean, and providing comfort.
self_preparedness.q10: know how to recognize when my baby needs medical attention and when to seek help from a healthcare provider.

support_person.q1: Do you have someone who can assist you during labor and delivery?
support_person.q3: Is your chosen support person willing to accompany you during labor and delivery?
support_person.q4: Is your support person available when you need to go to the healthcare facility?
support_person.q5: Does your support person know where you plan to give birth?
support_person.q6: Can your support person help arrange transportation when labor begins or during an emergency?
support_person.q7: Does your support person know the warning signs that may require immediate medical attention?
support_person.q8: Can your support person assist you in preparing the things needed for childbirth?
support_person.q9: Do you have another person who can assist you if your primary support person is unavailable?
support_person.q10: Do you feel that you have enough support from your family or chosen support person throughout your pregnancy and childbirth?

danger_signs.q1: Are you experiencing any vaginal bleeding or spotting?
danger_signs.q1_a: Yes, I am experiencing vaginal bleeding or heavy spotting
danger_signs.q1_b: I noticed slight spotting once, but I am keeping an eye on it
danger_signs.q1_c: No, but I had bleeding earlier in my pregnancy
danger_signs.q1_d: No, I am not experiencing any bleeding or spotting
danger_signs.q2: Are you experiencing a severe headache or blurred vision that does not go away?
danger_signs.q2_a: Yes, I am experiencing a severe headache or blurred vision right now
danger_signs.q2_b: I have a mild headache, but my vision is clear
danger_signs.q2_c: I feel slightly tired, but I do not have a headache or vision changes
danger_signs.q2_d: No, I am not experiencing any headaches or vision changes
danger_signs.q3: Are you experiencing severe pain in your stomach or upper belly (under your ribs)?
danger_signs.q3_a: Yes, I am experiencing severe pain in my stomach or upper belly
danger_signs.q3_b: I feel mild stretching or discomfort, but it is not severe
danger_signs.q3_c: I feel occasional mild cramping that comes and goes
danger_signs.q3_d: No, I am not experiencing any stomach or upper belly pain
danger_signs.q4: Have you had any convulsions, seizures, or sudden involuntary shaking?
danger_signs.q4_a: Yes, I have experienced a seizure, convulsion, or sudden shaking
danger_signs.q4_b: I felt sudden dizziness, but no shaking or seizure
danger_signs.q4_c: I felt unusually weak, but I had no sudden twitching or shaking
danger_signs.q4_d: No, I have not had any convulsions, seizures, or sudden shaking
danger_signs.q5: Do you have a fever accompanied by severe weakness or feeling extremely unwell?
danger_signs.q5_a: Yes, I have a fever and I feel severely weak or extremely unwell
danger_signs.q5_b: I feel warm and tired, but I do not have a high fever
danger_signs.q5_c: I feel normal fatigue from pregnancy, but no fever
danger_signs.q5_d: No, I do not have a fever or severe weakness
danger_signs.q6: Are you having difficulty breathing or feeling sudden shortness of breath?
danger_signs.q6_a: Yes, I am having severe difficulty breathing or sudden shortness of breath
danger_signs.q6_b: I feel slightly out of breath when I walk or climb stairs
danger_signs.q6_c: I feel a bit stuffy, but my breathing is fine
danger_signs.q6_d: No, I am breathing comfortably without any difficulty
danger_signs.q7: Have you noticed sudden swelling in your face or hands?
danger_signs.q7_a: Yes, I noticed sudden and noticeable swelling in my face or hands
danger_signs.q7_b: I have mild swelling in my feet or ankles at the end of the day
danger_signs.q7_c: My rings or shoes feel slightly tight, but my face looks normal
danger_signs.q7_d: No, I have not noticed any sudden swelling in my face or hands
danger_signs.q8: Are you experiencing any watery fluid leaking or gushing from your vagina?
danger_signs.q8_a: Yes, I am experiencing watery fluid leaking or gushing from my vagina
danger_signs.q8_b: I feel slightly damp, but it seems like normal pregnancy discharge
danger_signs.q8_c: I am not sure if fluid is leaking or if it is just urine
danger_signs.q8_d: No, I am not experiencing any fluid leaking from my vagina
danger_signs.q9: Have you noticed a significant decrease in your baby's movements, or has your baby stopped moving entirely?
danger_signs.q9_a: Yes, my baby is moving significantly less than usual or has stopped moving
danger_signs.q9_b: My baby seems a little quieter today, but is still moving
danger_signs.q9_c: My baby is moving at different times than usual, but is active
danger_signs.q9_d: No, my baby is kicking and moving normally
danger_signs.q10: If you are close to your due date, are you experiencing signs of labor or leaking fluid?
danger_signs.q10_a: Yes, I am experiencing strong contractions or leaking fluid near my due date
danger_signs.q10_b: I am feeling mild, irregular cramps that come and go
danger_signs.q10_c: I am feeling pressure in my lower belly, but no regular contractions
danger_signs.q10_d: No, I am not experiencing any signs of labor or fluid leakage
